stance_rationale: The package fails the alpha deliverable contract: referenced alpha_scores.parquet is a single forward Q5 snapshot with no Date column and no Date×Ticker×score time series. The strict IC/Harvey gates also fail, while the package rationalizes graduation using portfolio-level LO Q5 metrics and relaxed interpretation.

sub_stability.note: Reported stability is from single s3 diagnostics, not a separately shown ML composite subperiod audit.

dsr.note: DSR is LO Q5 portfolio-level, not OOS rank-IC DSR.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: Referenced alpha_scores.parquet has 69 rows and columns Ticker, Sector, ml_pred_forward, vrp_bkm, vol_60d_lag1, vkospi, beta_252d_lag1, mom_12_1_lag1; it has no Date column and is not the required multi-sig_date Date×Ticker×score artifact.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: Manual sign flips are used: score_s3 = -s3_vrp_vol and alpha_package describes negative_for_score_s3_meaning_LOW_VRP_x_vol_outperforms, not registered Z_Score_Aligned.
No Usable_Date column or Usable_Date <= sig_date enforcement is present in alpha_scores.parquet or scripts.
Scripts directly read .cache/rawdata.parquet and stage parquet artifacts via pd.read_parquet; no load_month_factors() route or factor_engine_proposal.R was found.
VKOSPI/regime variables are merged on same month sig_date and used as ML features; no explicit t-1 regime/overlay lag is shown.
No fundamental statement fields are used, so annual May and quarterly 45-day lag are not exercised.

critical_concerns.description: RF-A7 is triggered: alpha_scores.parquet is a single forward snapshot, lacks Date, and cannot support walk-forward reoptimization or the required Date×Ticker×score schema.
Strict alpha IC gates fail: ML OOS rank_IC is 0.0255 < 0.04 and OOS IC t_NW is 2.77 < 3.0; replacing this with LO Q5 portfolio t_NW changes the validation target.
The package uses explicit negative score construction instead of Z_Score_Aligned, so the sign-aware rescue of s3 is a manual sign flip under the PIT C13 rule.
Regime and option-derived market variables are used at the same sig_date without a demonstrated t-1 lag, especially VKOSPI feature and crisis diagnostics.
Turnover_q5_annual is 7.6056x, exceeding the hard <600% annual turnover constraint; 'net SR still strong' is not a valid override of a hard mandate.
The backtest universe enforces 20d TV >= 5e7 KRW, below the hard 2e8 KRW floor; historical s3 Q5 contains 119 rows below 1e8 and 354 below 2e8.
No challenge_note.md, artifact_lineage.json, weights.csv, covariance.parquet, or other 3-agent packages were found for this WT, so No Silent Override and AX-008 triangulation are not satisfied.

Academic implementation is weaker than claimed: references lack pages, BTZ HAR is admitted as bkm_var - rv_22d baseline, and VKOSPI validation is sample-check rather than full date-by-date comparison.

supporting_arguments: Exploratory cs_panel_v2.parquet does contain 185 monthly dates from 2010-12-30 to 2026-04-30, so a time-series research panel exists outside the delivered alpha_scores artifact.
Sector-neutral retention is 0.74297, so RF-A4 is not triggered on the reported s3 check.
The current 69-name forward alpha_scores selection passes the 2e8 KRW liquidity floor as of 2026-04-30, but the historical backtest universe does not.
unresolved_disputes: Whether the deployable alpha is the single s3 score or the ML XGBoost composite is inconsistent across the package, diagnostics, and alpha_scores.parquet.
The package claims graduation_eligible despite strict rank_IC and OOS IC t_NW failures.
Hybrid orthogonality is proxy-based, not measured against the actual STR_1715 + TSMOM + KR_10y returns.
The requested qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260508_011 path, weights.csv, and covariance.parquet are missing, so schedule, PSD, and condition-number checks cannot be verified.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that a single-date ML Q5 snapshot can be treated as a valid PIT alpha vector and graduated because LO Q5 portfolio metrics pass despite strict IC gates failing.
rebuttal_required: Rebuild alpha_scores.parquet as Date×Ticker×score_* with at least 60 monthly sig_dates, including Date and no forward-label leakage.
Re-run IC diagnostics on the exact deployable ML alpha, not on mixed single-signal and portfolio substitutes.
Replace manual sign inversion with registered Z_Score_Aligned evidence or formally reject the factor under PIT C13.
Re-run backtest with 20d TV >= 2e8 KRW and turnover <600% annual as hard constraints.
Provide challenge_note.md, artifact_lineage.json, missing 3-agent context, weights.csv, and covariance.parquet or state that this is alpha-only and not deployment-ready.
rationalization_red_flags: However LO Q5 t_NW gross 3.28 + net 3.09 PASS
However at 15bps×0.95% per-month cost, LO Q5 net SR = 0.825 still strong

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: The strongest external objection is artifact-contract failure, not economics: the research panel may be useful, but the emitted alpha package is not a PIT walk-forward alpha deliverable.

alpha_specific_questions: Can the exact ML alpha vector, not the s3 proxy, maintain rank_IC >= 0.04 and t_NW >= 3.0 under the same walk-forward schedule?
Where is the Date×Ticker×score alpha history that the optimizer will consume, and can it be regenerated without fwd_1m_ret leakage?
If AX-007 is claimed satisfied through ML sizing, what evidence shows the final max-20 long-only portfolio avoids the single-sleeve mechanism break?
